name: slide_sync
title: Sync Slidev deck
description: Syncs an existing talk-dir. A pre-migration talk-dir (one that holds a copy of the template; slide_dev and others stop with theme-none) is moved to a form that references the theme given by `theme`. Files that came from the template are deleted, and the work area (slides.md / pages/*.md / public/slides/) is kept. The deleted names are returned in migration.removed. A migrated talk-dir that references a theme (theme: in slides.md points to the theme in dependencies of package.json) fetches the theme at the version in the dependency and relinks node_modules, and aligns the generated files (vite.config.ts, start.mjs) with the current content of the plugin. Other files are left unchanged. To raise the theme version, rewrite the #<tag> of the dependency in package.json before calling. Returns the presentation categories (categories), the list of selectable layouts (layouts), and the lint result of the whole deck after the sync. A running slide_dev must be stopped with stop: true and started again.

dir.description: Absolute path of the talk-dir to sync. Relative paths are not accepted. Windows-style paths (C:\... / \\wsl.localhost\<distro>\...) are accepted and converted to an absolute path under /mnt/<drive>/ or inside WSL.

theme.description: Theme the pre-migration talk-dir should reference: `git+https://<host>/<owner>/<repo>.git#<tag>` or `file:<absolute path>`. Required for a pre-migration talk-dir (one that holds a copy of the template). Not used for a migrated talk-dir

node_modules_only.description: Only relink node_modules. The theme in package.json is fetched first, then linked (no network access if it is already fetched). A migrated talk-dir that references a theme behaves the same even when this is omitted. The generated files (vite.config.ts, start.mjs) are also aligned with the current content of the plugin. Cannot be specified together with theme

event.description: slide.sync.done on success; slide.sync.error or runtime-dependencies.unavailable on failure (omitted when a path argument is rejected)

dir.description: Absolute path of the synced talk-dir (success only)

nodeModulesTarget.description: Where node_modules of the talk-dir links to (success only)

nodeModulesOnly.description: Whether only node_modules was relinked (success only)

spec.description: Theme specification in the dependencies of package.json

directory.description: Absolute path of the theme root

theme.description: Theme the talk-dir references, or null when it references none (success only)

removed.description: Names of the files from the template that were deleted

migration.description: Result of moving a pre-migration talk-dir onto the theme, or null when it was not moved (success only)

id.description: Category ID that layouts[].category refers to

question.description: Question that tells when to choose the category

categories.description: Presentation categories declared by the theme (success only)

category.description: Category ID (uncategorized when unset or unknown)

deprecated.description: Whether the layout is deprecated (not to be chosen)

filename.description: File name of the reference yaml

layouts.description: Selectable layouts (hidden layouts are excluded) (success only)

skipped.description: Whether the lint could not run (the generation or sync still succeeds)

detail.description: Why the lint could not run (only when skipped)

outcome.description: clean (no violations), violations (some found), no-target (no file to lint)

file.description: Path relative to the talk-dir (absolute when outside it)

skippedSymlinkDirectories.description: Symlinked directories under pages/ that were not linted (relative to the talk-dir)

lint.description: Lint result of the whole deck (success only)

expectedAt.description: Where the missing runtime dependencies or Playwright Chromium are expected (failure only, kind runtime-dependencies-not-installed / chromium-not-installed / chromium-install-failed)

invalidPaths.description: Rejected path arguments as <parameter>=<value> (failure only, kind invalid-path)

convertedPaths.description: Windows-style path arguments converted before the rejection, keyed by parameter name (failure only, kind invalid-path; omitted when nothing was converted)

detail.description: Full text of the failure and how to recover (failure only)

log.description: Raw output of the command or child process (failure only). Over 64KB, the end is kept and the first line notes the truncation

warnings.description: Warnings raised during the run (omitted when there are none). Beyond 100 warnings or 64KB, the last item tells how many were omitted
